$comment: The instruction-surface census as an anchor rather than a snapshot. Written by scripts/check-instruction-surface.js alone; scripts/resolve-ticket.js and scripts/guard-issue-close.sh also read it (#1876, #1913).

COUNTS are re-measured on every daily repo-checks run. VERDICTS are behavioural (mantahostels#886) and are re-measured only when the digest beside them moves. A guard's digest hashes its code with comments and layout dropped, so a comment-only edit moves none (#1876, scripts/lib/census-digest.js), and a shell guard's also hashes each docs/agents/rules/ file its code names, so a reworded rule moves it (#1914).

Re-anchoring with --rebaseline asserts that you re-measured what moved. Nothing checks that you did. --only <key>[,<key>...] (mantahostels#2105) narrows a re-anchor to named guards/poolFiles rel paths, hookCommands keys (spelt as below) and the `hooks` or `skills` count (#1879), leaving every other row reporting. A new guard's row is written by hand with an empty digest, then --only fills it.
Digests and pool bytes are anchored at the census's own tree (measuredAt.tree), not at the day this file was written: --rebaseline --at <rev>.
A verdict has two halves and both are recorded: `verdict` is timing (does it fire at the moment of need), `selfSufficient` is whether what it prints carries the rule.

guards holds every hook-wired script that prints rule text, plus check-roadmap-valid.js, a pre-commit checker that does, and check-weakens-line.js, a commit-msg one (#2235). name-issue-session.sh and clear-rule-latch.sh were measured and print no rule, so carry no verdict to anchor.
hookCommands anchors each hook entry's full live command text under the checker's buildHookKey: `<event> <scriptPath>`, plus ` if <cond>` where the entry has an `if` condition (#1604).

measuredAt.tree: 437c94164; a row whose `source` is not #1604 was re-measured under that ticket, at its tree. `hooks` and the docs/working-contract.md pool bytes, which carry no `source`, were re-anchored under #1879 at 89ff86007, and the CLAUDE.md pool bytes under #2073 at 2779798ac; the pool bytes and rule inventory, `hooks` and `skills` under #2263 at a6d66be90; the twelve hook entries added since, and the two guards among them, under #2586 at 2d182ffc6

scripts/guard-dispatch-rewrite.sh.verdict: at need — it rewrites the dispatch itself rather than warning, so the fix is already applied when the session reads the note; the watch or end-the-turn note, and a wrong-tier or untracked-search rule, arrive as the agent launches; a subagent's own dispatch is denied before it runs.
scripts/guard-dispatch-rewrite.sh.selfSufficient: yes — the watch command, the stop-on-completion step and the abandon condition are all in the note, on the prompt's own artefact as on a supplied one; a dispatch with none is told to end the turn; the burn note names its off switch; a tripped tier or search rule prints its whole fragment once a session, and the subagent deny prints the whole rule. The supplied Artefact line reaches the subagent with two instructions, to append findings as they land and to search a long source on disk rather than read it whole; a prompt already naming a usable artefact gets neither

scripts/guard-priced-options.js.verdict: under-researched limb — at need (the Stop carrying the round, before it reaches the founder), and it reaches past the session ceiling and is capped at 3 of its own. Shape limb — at need below SESSION_MAX=5, quiet above it; a round the under-researched or close-rivals check refuses while the shape limb is silent has its shape faults named in that refusal and its unchanged re-send refused on shape until fixed, so past the ceiling only a misshapen round neither check refuses — caught by neither the close nor the low-top test and sent after 10+ tool calls, or past a spent cap or a tool-call count the transcript cannot give — passes unrefused. Research-ladder limb — at need (the Stop carrying a close-refused question re-sent still caught, close or low-top, with a rung untried), past the session ceiling, capped at 3 of its own.
scripts/guard-priced-options.js.selfSufficient: yes — both limbs carry defect, rule text and fix inline; shape template detail by pointer to core-voice.md; a shape hold names each shape fault and says the question passes once its shape is right; the refusal that spends the under-researched or close-rivals cap says that check will not refuse the re-send, and promises no refusal; the founder-act limb refuses a ticket-comment back-reference at need, naming the phrase and printing the hand-over rule inline; the research-ladder refusal names the missing rungs, their order and budgets, the subagent's prompt and the delegated-decision line inline, and its cap-spending refusal says it will not refuse the re-send; the house-decision text the under-researched and close-rivals refusals inline says "Any other choice is a delegated decision" and names `node scripts/record-delegated-decision.js <n>` to record it
